basics.name: Ally Madrone
basics.label: Product leader, AI systems for trust and safety and fraud investigation
basics.summary: Ally Madrone is VP of Product at Deep Media, a content security infrastructure company trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms. He builds AI systems that detect synthetic media and disrupt fraud networks, and he speaks widely on AI-enabled financial crime.

work.name: Deep Media
work.summary: Content security infrastructure company. Owns product strategy and roadmap across the platform: a composable API and MCP tool layer (detection, retrieval, provenance, and case assembly), Skills composed from those tools, Guardian agents that proactively investigate fraud, disinformation, and other digital harms across the surface, deep, and dark web, and an auditable evidence vault underneath. Deep Media's work is trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms. Stood up all-layer web threat intelligence, built the dark web collection feed for government and brand risk monitoring, and closed a custom data feed agreement with a government contractor.

work.name: Trust Stamp
work.summary: Biometric authentication and synthetic identity detection for financial services. First North American go-to-market hire: built a $10MM+ pipeline from a flat territory and hired and managed seven U.S. sales reps. Authored the PRD for the deepfake detection API from scratch, evaluated internal R&D models against it, and packaged detection for financial crime, KYC, and identity fraud use cases. Authored the technical responses to federal RFIs.

work.name: Veriff
work.summary: Global identity verification platform. Promoted from team lead to a quota-carrying enterprise role in eight months. Worked a $4MM+ enterprise pipeline and beat quota by 25% or more for five consecutive quarters. Ran six-month enterprise procurement cycles with General Counsels, CISOs, and Heads of Fraud at financial institutions.

work.name: Veriff
work.summary: Veriff's first U.S. hire. Opened the U.S. market with no playbook, wrote the sales development strategy, and scaled the team from one to twelve in under a year. The team generated $50MM+ in new pipeline in its first twelve months.

work.name: SheerID
work.summary: Mapped buying committees across 200 target accounts to book meetings with VP-level marketing buyers at Fortune 500 retail brands.

work.name: Root Connection
work.summary: Founded a research and design firm and grew it from zero to $1MM in annual revenue in two years, then ran it profitably for six. Signed 50+ client contracts over six years, built the marketing engine, ran operations and accounting, managed crews and 15+ vendors, and advised regulated agriculture clients on licensing and compliance.

work.name: One Green World
work.summary: Managed a $500K+ wholesale book of business and drove B2B retail expansion for a specialty nursery. Concurrent with Root Connection.

work.name: Oregon Health & Science University
work.summary: Coordinated Phase 3 clinical trials: protocol adherence, human-subject scheduling and consent, procurement, and cross-department coordination in a regulated research environment.

awards.title: Winner, Safety by Design Trust & Safety Hackathon (team FaceLock)
